{{Top|leg}}
The '''Podracing Open''' was a series of four [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] courses on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. This series was preceded by the [[Galactic Trials]] and followed by the [[Hutt Championships]].<ref name="RRG">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref> It was held for at least one [[Standard year/Legends|year]], in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="EP1note">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', which includes the appearance of the [[Podracing Open]], takes place eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars: Racer Revenge'' must take place in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], which predates the [[Declaration of a New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by five years, according to ''The New Essential Chronology''.</ref>

==Tournament structure==
The Podracing Open took place across four [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="EP1note" /> As in the [[Galactic Trials]] and the [[Hutt Championships]], commentary was provided by [[Dax Gazaway]].<ref name="RRG" />
#[[The Brightlands]] ([[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]])
#[[Badlands (Tatooine)/Legends|Badlands]] ([[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]])
#[[Ballast Complex]] ([[Dac/Legends|Dac]])
#[[Ruins of Carnuss Gorgull/Legends|Ruins of Carnuss Gorgull]] ([[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]])<ref name="RRG" />

==Track favorites==
Four [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] attained the status of track favorite by 24 BBY.<ref name="EP1note" />
#[[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]]
#[[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]]
#[[Knire Dark]]
#[[Kraid Nemmeso]]<ref name="RRG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Podracing Open is the second playable podracing tournament in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', and can be unlocked by finishing in at least third place on the final track of the Galactic Trials. By either defeating or placing higher than them, the track favorites can be unlocked as playable.<ref name="RRG" />
